gloss: hot stone bath; hot stone spa

definitions.gloss: hot stone bath; hot stone spa
definitions.explanation: A type of spa treatment where one lies on heated flat stones, typically wearing light clothing, to induce sweating. Believed to have detox and relaxation benefits.

examples.japanese: {岩盤浴|がんばんよく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かいた。
examples.english: I sweated a lot in the hot stone bath.

examples.japanese: {岩盤浴|がんばんよく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧だ。
examples.english: This is my first time doing a hot stone bath.

notes:
{岩盤浴|がんばんよく} is done wearing provided light clothes ({館内着|かんないぎ}) and lying on heated natural stones. It's a popular amenity at ⟦スーパー{銭湯|せんとう}→スーパー銭湯：09831_suupaasentou⟧ and ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧ランド. Sessions typically last 15-20 minutes.
